title: Proper derived direct image comparison between small and big etale sites
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Use the size convention [def-weil-size-convention] and the big etale sites $B_X,B_Y$ and geometric morphisms $\pi_X,\pi_Y$ of [lem-trf-big-small-etale-exact-retraction]. Let $f_s$ be the induced morphism of small etale topoi, and $f_b:\mathrm{Sh}(B_X)\to\mathrm{Sh}(B_Y)$ the relocalization morphism whose inverse image is $(f_b^{-1}H)(T\to X)=H(T\to X\to Y)$. Use ordinary right derived direct images of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and bounded-below subcategories [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories]. For every $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{Et}})$ with torsion cohomology sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the canonical comparison is an isomorphism
$$\pi_Y^{-1}Rf_{s,*}K\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{b,*}\pi_X^{-1}K\quad\text{in }D^+(\mathrm{Ab}(B_Y)).$$
The comparison is the base-change transformation for the commutative square $\pi_Y\circ f_b\cong f_s\circ\pi_X$, formed from its inverse/direct-image adjunctions. There is no common annihilator or invertibility assumption on the torsion orders.
